start.title: A Life in Haran
start.text:
You live in Haran with your father Terah, your wife Sarai, and your nephew Lot.
You are seventy-five years old.

choices.text: Live as Abram in Haran, seventy-five years old
Live as a young man in the city of Ur
Live as king over a great nation

the_call.title: The Call of the Lord
the_call.text:
The Lord speaks to you.
What does He command?

choices.text: 'Go from your country, your people and your father's household to the land I will show you'
'Stay in Haran and worship the household idols'
'Build a temple to Me here in Haran'

the_promise.title: The Promise
the_promise.text:
The Lord adds His promise.
What does He say?

choices.text: 'I will make you into a great nation and bless you; all peoples on earth will be blessed through you'
'I will give you great riches to keep to yourself'
'You will have a long life and no descendants'

telling_sarah.title: Your Household
telling_sarah.text:
You must prepare your family for the journey.
Who goes with you?

choices.text: Take Sarai your wife and Lot your nephew
Leave Sarai behind in Haran
Go alone with only a walking staff

preparing.title: What You Carry
preparing.text:
You gather what you will take on the journey.
What goes with you?

choices.text: All the possessions and people you have acquired in Haran
Only a small bag of bread
A chariot of gold from the king of Haran

departure.title: You Set Out
departure.text:
The time has come to leave.
Where do you set out for?

choices.text: Set out for the land of Canaan
Set out for Egypt to become rich
Set out with no destination in mind

the_road.title: Into the Land
the_road.text:
You travel through the land of Canaan.
How far do you go?

choices.text: Travel as far as the great tree of Moreh at Shechem
Turn back to Haran halfway there
Cross the sea to a distant island

doubt_night.title: The Lord Appears
doubt_night.text:
At Shechem the Lord appears to you.
What does He say?

choices.text: 'To your offspring I will give this land'
'This land belongs to another people forever'
'Return to Haran; you were wrong to come'

stargazing.title: At Shechem
stargazing.text: You have heard the promise. What do you do at Shechem?

choices.text: Build an altar there to the Lord who appeared to you
Build a palace of cedar for yourself
Say nothing and move on quickly

canaan_arrival.title: Between Bethel and Ai
canaan_arrival.text:
You move on from Shechem into the hills.
Where do you stop and pitch your tent?

choices.text: Pitch your tent in the hills between Bethel and Ai, and build another altar
Pitch your tent in the city of Sodom
Sail back across the river to Haran

altar.title: Calling on the Name of the Lord
altar.text:
You call on the name of the Lord at your new altar.
The promise of a great nation goes with you as you journey on toward the Negev.
